show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/NRRC4V
show.description: Dev Singhania lives as an ordinary man, hiding the truth that he is the legendary Kohinoor King and a doctor. When his wife Aisha and daughter Kiara are pushed into danger by cruel families and dark conspiracies, Dev is forced to awaken his true identity. Love, sacrifice, and revenge drive him to reclaim his throne, crush his enemies, and rewrite destiny as the Kohinoor King: an unstoppable force feared across the world.
